Additional selector syntax fixes and performance
Recorded 2026-11-01

Fixed 45 additional assertions across 10 files, with zero new mismatch keys.
Before: 16,406 / 18,469 pass (88.83%); 2,063 mismatches.
After:  16,451 / 18,469 pass (89.07%); 2,018 mismatches.
Selection and unsupported-capability counts are unchanged.

Implementation

31 user-action pseudo-class restrictions on view-transition/highlight pseudo-elements;
 4 :host-context() compound-selector argument constraints;
 4 missing functional arguments;
 6 wrong pseudo-class versus pseudo-element spellings.

Lightning CSS is unchanged and remains the sole CSS parser. Host-context arguments
are serialized from existing native tokens and passed back to the native Selector
parser with full-input consumption. A native AST walk rejects combinators and
pseudo-elements in that compound argument. No replacement grammar is introduced.

Current version-review findings

Ten remaining ::part() structural/tree pseudo-class assertions differ from the
current CSS Pseudo 4 element-backed model, which permits syntax but prevents
matching. Three tentative functional :has-slotted() mismatches also need proposal/
test alignment. They remain unresolved and counted; no expectations are changed.
Sources and exact keys: selector-specification-review.json.

Validation

305 existing style tests and 32 declaration-validation tests pass. Offline cargo
check passes. The full audit scanned 35,417 files and 32,021 literal helper calls,
with zero dependency parser panics and zero new mismatch keys. The audit exits
101 because the remaining 2,018 mismatches are asserted by the diagnostic runner.
No new test code or image suite execution. Counts are syntax assertions, including
syntax-only computed helpers; they are not whole-file or rendering pass rates.

Performance

Positive means slower. 15 paired runs per case, alternating before/after order,
pinned CPU 6; 240 total process runs. Existing benchmark sources are unchanged.
Identical frozen native/support dependencies, rustc opt-level=2, debuginfo=0.
Frequency/boost is uncontrolled on a shared host. Diagnostic 95% bootstrap ranges
use paired medians, 5,000 resamples, no multiple-comparison correction.
EPUB totals sum five fixture medians; they do not represent a single page.
Cold means uncached author programs with machine/default-CSS caches warmed.

The selector workload uses 64 classes with ::selection, view-transition :only-child
and :host-context(.scope), accepted in both builds with equivalent synthetic
matching outcomes. Native host-context validation adds serialization/reparsing
during preparation. Allocation and peak-byte changes, complete per-sample times,
fixture contents and all raw measurements are retained in the performance files.
Unchanged HTML parsing and indexing stages also vary, suggesting host noise;
intervals do not isolate the causal cost of the code change.
The selector-heavy cold fixtures add 192-384 allocations per preparation (+8.3%
to +16.2%). Cached selector fixture allocations are unchanged. Tracked peak bytes
are unchanged for these fixtures in both modes.

Remaining

2,018 current mismatches: 178 confirmed dependency blocks and 1,840 unresolved.
The registry retains all 2,236 original observations, including 218 now fixed
across both local-fix stages. Original actual/native fields retain snapshot meaning.
Previous local-fix-report.* and local-fix-performance.* remain prior-stage history.
The current source delta is confined to style/02-syntax/selectors.rs.
No Lightning CSS, renderer, GPUI, test source, capability exclusions or expectation
changes were made in this stage. All build outputs use disk-backed caches.

Exact fixed keys: selector-fix-results.jsonl.
Latest mismatches: selector-fix-after-mismatches.jsonl.
